svg.text: Sound exposes both oscillators at once. Shape groups the filter and amplifier as one signal-shaping stage. Only informative, compact previews remain.
Hierarchy: Sound is 354 / 132 for primary oscillator editing versus secondary voice/mix. Shape is 306 / 180 for filter versus amp.
Previews are compact and informational only: filter response and combined ADSR shape. Oscillator waveform is selected directly by name; no decorative scope.
